mapper.sql: id, name, source_url, normalized_url, summary, organizer, start_time, end_time, audit_status, submission_source, submitter_id, submitter_ip, reviewer_id, reject_reason, reward_granted, reward_quota, approved_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_competition (name, source_url, normalized_url, summary, organizer, start_time, end_time, audit_status, submission_source, submitter_id, submitter_ip, reviewer_id, reward_granted, reward_quota, approved_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{sourceUrl}, #{normalizedUrl}, #{summary}, #{organizer}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{auditStatus}, #{submissionSource}, #{submitterId}, #{submitterIp}, #{reviewerId}, #{rewardGranted}, #{rewardQuota}, #{approvedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_competition WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM ai_competition WHERE audit_status = 'APPROVED'
AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time < #{now} AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= #{now})
ORDER BY
end_time DESC
CASE WHEN start_time IS NOT NULL AND start_time > #{now} THEN 1 WHEN start_time IS NULL AND end_time IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(start_time, create_time) ASC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_competition WHERE audit_status = 'APPROVED'
AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time < #{now} AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_competition SET audit_status = 'APPROVED', reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reject_reason = NULL, reward_granted = #{rewardGranted}, reward_quota = #{rewardQuota}, approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND audit_status = 'PENDING'
